notes.method_notes: Checkpoint ships via Google Drive (unreachable here); obtained from the ModelScope mirror jhy11111/cut3r and present locally. The six-view question IS now resolved by perturbation on the real checkpoint: state flows forward only, so the target camera is fed LAST and each of the other five then changes its depth by 0.12-1.57 m max. In the natural order the target sat third and was bit-identical when views 3-5 were replaced by noise -- a three-view row labelled six-view.
